title: Improving Rationality in the Reasoning Process of Language Models through Self-playing Game
authors_zh: Pinzheng Wang、Juntao Li、Zecheng Tang、Haijia Gui、Min Zhang
paper_type_zh: 批评辨别自博弈数据与反馈训练配方
best_for_zh: 希望复用自博弈推理反馈数据、核查角色奖励与发布边界，或研究批评采纳与拒绝机制的读者
one_line: CDG generates one-step Prover–Critic–revision episodes and converts correctness- thresholded helpful, misleading, corrected, and resistant outcomes into role-specific training data.
CDG 生成一次 Prover—Critic—修订回合，并把通过正确性阈值筛选的纠错、误导、修正与抗误导结果转成分角色训练数据。
why: It provides a concrete open recipe for constructing reasoning-feedback data while exposing how answer-only verification, exact-phrase rewards, correlated self-play, and incomplete release lineage can shape the resulting supervision.
inclusion_reason: CDG is an open self-play construction recipe that turns correctness-routed reasoning episodes into Prover and critic supervision, with explicit selection thresholds, official code, linked rollout data, and auditable verifier and release limitations.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reasoning models can produce a correct answer yet abandon it after a plausible false criticism, or produce a wrong answer yet fail to use a valid diagnosis. CDG treats this distinction—not raw problem solving alone—as a data-construction problem: the training record must show whether a model should accept or reject feedback and what happened after that decision.

The semantic unit is a one-exchange episode (question, initial solution, critique, revised solution). To interpret it, a curator also needs the reference answer, initial and final correctness, routed critic role, self-play loop, selection result, and checkpoint provenance. These fields distinguish four materially different outcomes: correcting an error, failing to correct it, resisting a fabricated error, and being misled away from a correct solution.

This object belongs in the data-construction and open-release-recipes track because the paper specifies a pipeline from benchmark training questions through role-conditioned generation, answer verification, multi-sample revision tests, thresholded selection, and role-specific fine-tuning. The official repository exposes code and links rollout data and a checkpoint, but it does not provide a single immutable manifest joining every raw question, sampled episode, verifier decision, selected training record, and trained model.

推理模型可能先得到正确答案，却被一段貌似合理的错误批评带偏；也可能先答错，却无法利用真正指出问题的反馈。CDG 不只训练“把题做对”，而是把是否应当采纳批评、采纳后发生了什么，转化为可筛选的训练数据。

它的语义记录单位是一次 (question, initial solution, critique, revised solution) 回合。要正确解释该回合，还必须关联标准答案、修订前后正确性、Critic 路由角色、自博弈轮次、筛选结果和 checkpoint 来源。由此才能区分四种不同事件：纠正错误、未能纠错、抵抗伪造批评，以及被误导后放弃正确答案。

这项工作适合“数据构建与开放发布配方”赛道，因为论文给出了从 benchmark 训练题、分角色生成、答案校验、多次修订测试、阈值筛选到角色微调的完整链路。官方仓库公开了代码，并链接 rollout 数据和模型，但尚未提供一个不可变清单，把原始题目、所有采样回合、校验结果、入选训练记录和模型逐条连接起来。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
CDG assigns one policy family three roles. The Prover first solves a question. If the extracted answer is wrong, a Helpful Critic is asked to identify and explain the first mistake without supplying the complete solution. If the answer is correct, a Misleading Critic fabricates a plausible error. The Prover then sees the critique without being told its intent and must either revise the answer or reject the criticism.

Outcome verification is deliberately simple: a regex extractor obtains the final answer and a SymPy-based grader compares it with the reference. A Helpful Critic succeeds when an initially wrong solution becomes correct; a Misleading Critic succeeds when an initially correct solution becomes incorrect. The Prover succeeds by correcting after useful feedback or retaining correctness under misleading feedback. In the formal reward, resistance to misleading feedback is scaled by eta.

The main optimizer is ReST. Multiple revisions are sampled for each critique, then threshold rules convert successful behavior into Prover, Helpful-Critic, and Misleading-Critic SFT datasets. DPO and PPO appear as ablations, not as the main released recipe. This feedback contract is mixed: mathematical answer comparison is programmatic, while the critique and revision are language-model actions whose process validity is inferred only from the final answer and an exact rejection phrase.

CDG 让同一模型家族分别扮演 Prover、Helpful Critic 和 Misleading Critic。Prover 先解题；若抽取出的答案错误，Helpful Critic 需要指出并解释第一个错误，但不能直接给完整解答；若答案正确，Misleading Critic 则编造一个看似可信的错误。Prover 看到 Critic 内容，却不知道其真实意图，只能自行决定修订或拒绝。

环境反馈很简洁：正则表达式抽取最终答案，SymPy grader 与标准答案做等价比较。Helpful Critic 在错误答案被改正确时成功；Misleading Critic 在正确答案被改错时成功。Prover 的成功条件则是接受有效反馈并纠错，或面对误导反馈仍保持正确；形式化奖励中，后者由 eta 加权。

主方法使用 ReST：每条 critique 先采样多次 revision，再用阈值把成功行为转成 Prover、Helpful Critic 和 Misleading Critic 的 SFT 数据。DPO 与 PPO 只是消融。这里的反馈契约属于 mixed：答案比较可程序化执行，但 critique 与 revision 是模型动作，其过程是否合理只通过最终答案和一个固定拒绝短语间接判断。

title: Method
方法
html:
The main self-play pool combines all 7,473 GSM8K training questions with 12,000 questions from the MATH training set. For each question, the Prover samples four initial solutions. Each incorrect question–solution pair receives eight Helpful-Critic samples; each correct pair receives four Misleading-Critic samples. For every question–solution–critique triplet, the Prover samples four revisions. Rollout decoding uses temperature 0.95, top-p 0.95, top-k 5, and maximum length 4,096.

The paper sets Prover, Misleading-Critic, and Helpful-Critic selection thresholds to 0.5, 0.75, and 0.5. Concretely, a helpful critique is retained if at least two of four revisions become correct. A misleading critique is retained if at least three of four revisions fail to emit \boxed{This critic is not critical.} and turn a correct answer into an incorrect one. The Prover set balances 10,000 initially correct, 10,000 misleading-resistant, and 10,000 helpful-corrected examples.

Selected Prover records become multi-turn conversations containing the question, initial answer, critique, and revision; critic records become instruction/output pairs. Official scripts use intermediate fields including prompt, responses, response, metadata, round1_response, critic, conversations, instruction, input, output, system, and mask_history. The repository's data/train.jsonl contains 19,473 raw source questions with answer and provenance-like metadata, not the selected rollout release linked on Google Drive.

The paper describes two self-play/training iterations and reports learning rates of 5e-6 then 1e-6, batch sizes 32 then 256, one epoch for the Prover and Misleading Critic, and two epochs for the Helpful Critic. The checked main.sh instead defaults to three loops, updates role checkpoints across loops, leaves environment-specific paths unconfigured, and does not constitute a pinned reproduction manifest. This paper–script gap should be resolved before claiming exact replication.

主自博弈题池由 GSM8K 全部 7,473 道训练题和 MATH 训练集中的 12,000 道题组成。每题先生成四个 Prover 初始解；每个错误的“题目—解答”对生成八条 Helpful Critic，每个正确对生成四条 Misleading Critic；随后每个“题目—初始解—critique”三元组再生成四个 Prover revision。rollout 解码参数为 temperature 0.95、top-p 0.95、top-k 5，最大长度 4,096。

论文给出的 Prover、Misleading Critic、Helpful Critic 阈值分别为 0.5、0.75、0.5。具体而言，四次 revision 中至少两次改对，Helpful Critic 才入选；至少三次没有输出 \boxed{This critic is not critical.} 且把原正确答案改错，Misleading Critic 才入选。Prover 训练集则平衡抽取 10,000 条初始正确、10,000 条抗误导成功和 10,000 条接受有效批评后纠正的样本。

入选的 Prover 记录被转换成包含问题、初始回答、critique 与 revision 的多轮对话；Critic 记录转换成 instruction/output 对。官方脚本中可见 prompt、responses、response、metadata、round1_response、critic、conversations、instruction、input、output、system 与 mask_history 等中间字段。仓库内的 data/train.jsonl 是含答案和来源元数据的 19,473 条原始题目，不等于 Google Drive 上链接的 rollout 语料。

论文描述两轮自博弈与训练：学习率依次为 5e-6 和 1e-6，batch size 为 32 和 256；Prover、Misleading Critic 各训练一轮，Helpful Critic 训练两轮。当前官方 main.sh 却默认运行三轮、跨轮更新角色 checkpoint，并包含占位路径，因此不能直接视为论文实验的固定运行清单。复现前必须先解决这处论文—脚本差异。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On the paper's main pass@1 / maj@8 / maj@32 evaluation, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct moves from 85.3 / 91.2 / 93.0 to 86.8 / 92.0 / 93.1 on GSM8K and from 49.4 / 58.3 / 63.4 to 51.7 / 60.7 / 66.0 on MATH500 after CDG-2. The first round is mixed: GSM8K pass@1 rises to 85.5 while maj@8 and maj@32 fall, and all three MATH500 metrics fall to 49.0 / 56.8 / 62.2.

Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct also shows non-monotonic rounds. Its MATH500 metrics rise from 55.4 / 58.6 / 62.9 to 57.6 / 62.9 / 66.2 after CDG-1, then fall to 56.1 / 61.5 / 65.6 after CDG-2. For Llama-3.1-8B-Base with the extra 30,000-example imitation stage, MATH500 improves from 29.4 / 36.5 / 42.6 to 33.8 / 39.2 / 43.6 after CDG-2, while CDG-1 is again mixed.

The paper further evaluates stepwise error detection, self-correction, and long-chain reasoning. Those experiments do not isolate the main CDG episode corpus: stepwise-error data uses multiple Llama solutions and GPT-4o annotations, self-correction data selects final-correct two-pass traces and removes loops, and long-chain data uses QwQ-32B-Preview plus additional filtering. They support utility of the broader training design in the reported settings, not exclusive causality from the released CDG rollouts.

Official code corroborates the role prompts, sample multiplicities, answer extraction, threshold selection, exact rejection phrase, and conversion formats. Benchmark changes are not evidence that every critique identifies a real first error, every solution trace is faithful, the rollout corpus is diverse or uncontaminated, or the public release has complete lineage. Repository evaluation numbers use different decoding and harness settings from the paper table and should not be merged into one comparison.

在论文的 pass@1 / maj@8 / maj@32 主评测中，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 经 CDG-2 后，GSM8K 从 85.3 / 91.2 / 93.0 变为 86.8 / 92.0 / 93.1，MATH500 从 49.4 / 58.3 / 63.4 变为 51.7 / 60.7 / 66.0。不过第一轮并非全面提升：GSM8K 只有 pass@1 升至 85.5，其余两项下降；MATH500 三项均降至 49.0 / 56.8 / 62.2。

Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 同样不是轮次越多越好。其 MATH500 从 55.4 / 58.6 / 62.9 经 CDG-1 升至 57.6 / 62.9 / 66.2，但 CDG-2 又回落至 56.1 / 61.5 / 65.6。Llama-3.1-8B-Base 先接受额外 30,000 条 imitation 数据后，MATH500 从 29.4 / 36.5 / 42.6 提升到 CDG-2 的 33.8 / 39.2 / 43.6，而 CDG-1 仍呈混合结果。

论文还评估逐步错误检测、自我纠错和长链推理，但这些实验并未隔离主 CDG 回合语料：逐步错误检测使用多条 Llama 解答和 GPT-4o 标注；自我纠错语料筛选两次作答后最终正确的轨迹并删除循环；长链语料使用 QwQ-32B-Preview 并另行过滤。因此这些结果支持更宽泛训练设计在给定设置中的效用，不能全部归因于已发布的 CDG rollout。

官方代码与论文在角色 prompt、采样次数、答案抽取、阈值筛选、固定拒绝短语和转换格式上相互印证。但 benchmark 数值变化不能证明每条 critique 都找到了真实的首个错误、每条推理都忠实、语料无污染或发布谱系完整。仓库 README 中的评测采用不同解码与 harness，也不应与论文表格混成同一组比较。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive supervision signal is not simply self-correction. CDG creates paired pressure in opposite directions: accept a critique when it exposes an error, but reject it when it attacks a correct solution. This turns critique discernment into a game outcome and makes both correction and resistance reusable as training data.

Unlike a process reward model, CDG does not score every reasoning step. Unlike debate with an external judge, it routes critic roles using ground-truth final-answer correctness and judges the exchange by the revised final answer. Unlike ordinary rejection sampling, it trains the agents that generate feedback as well as the agent that consumes it. Helpful and misleading critics are prompted similarly to reduce trivial style cues, though their content can still reveal the role.

The episode therefore has unusual audit value when all branches are retained: it can reveal whether a critique was accepted, whether acceptance improved correctness, and whether an adversarial critique changed a correct result. That value disappears if the release keeps only final SFT conversations without initial correctness, role, multi-sample outcomes, rejection reasons, loop, and verifier provenance.

CDG 的关键监督不是普通 self-correction，而是同时施加两个相反目标：批评真实有效时要接受，批评针对正确答案而伪造时要拒绝。这样，纠错能力与抗误导能力都成为游戏结果，并都可以转成训练样本。

它不等同于 process reward model，因为没有逐步给推理打分；也不同于由外部 judge 裁决的 debate，因为角色路由依赖标准答案正确性，最终仍看修订后的答案。与常规 rejection sampling 相比，它不仅训练消费反馈的 Prover，也训练产生反馈的两个 Critic。Helpful Critic 与 Misleading Critic 使用相近 prompt，减少最明显的风格线索，但具体内容仍可能泄露角色。

若保留所有分支，这种 episode 对审计很有价值：可以检查 critique 是否被采纳、采纳后是否纠错，以及对抗 critique 是否把正确答案带偏。若发布物只剩最终 SFT 对话，而没有初始正确性、角色、多次 revision、拒绝原因、轮次和 verifier 来源，这种价值就会显著丢失。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Final-answer verification is a weak proxy for rational process. A derivation can contain invalid steps yet land on the correct answer, while regex extraction or SymPy comparison can reject an equivalent expression. The pipeline does not independently verify that a Helpful Critic found the first causal error or that a Misleading Critic's claim is genuinely plausible.

The exact phrase \boxed{This critic is not critical.} participates in selection, creating a format-sensitive shortcut. A model can learn the rejection token pattern without assessing the critique, and a semantically valid rejection in another form can fail selection. Because the three roles come from the same model family, they can share correlated misconceptions or co-adapt to private lexical conventions. Similar prompts reduce obvious role-style leakage but do not eliminate content leakage.

Evidence is mixed across rounds and models, and later self-play is not uniformly better. Separate GPT-4o-, self-correction-, and QwQ-assisted data pipelines complicate causal attribution for downstream tasks. The official training script's loop defaults and learning-rate ordering do not cleanly match the paper description, and tracked filenames containing vertical bars make ordinary repository checkout fail on Windows.

Release auditing remains incomplete. The linked Google Drive folder was not independently enumerated, and no immutable version, checksums, exact rollout schema, accepted/rejected counts, or end-to-end item lineage was verified. The repository has no top-level license at the checked commit, and code, rollout-data, and checkpoint licenses remain unknown. No item-level decontamination, near-duplicate, role-leakage, or verifier-calibration audit was found.

只看最终答案并不能证明推理过程合理。错误推导可能偶然得到正确答案，正则抽取或 SymPy 比较也可能漏掉等价表达。流程没有独立验证 Helpful Critic 是否真的找到了第一个因果错误，也没有判断 Misleading Critic 编造的错误是否足够可信。

固定字符串 \boxed{This critic is not critical.} 直接参与筛选，形成明显的格式捷径：模型可能学会输出拒绝标记而不分析 critique，语义正确但措辞不同的拒绝也可能被判失败。三个角色来自同一模型家族，容易共享错误或共同适应私有表达习惯；相近 prompt 只能减少表层风格泄漏，不能消除内容泄漏。

不同轮次和不同模型上的证据并不一致，后续自博弈也不是稳定更好。GPT-4o 标注、自我纠错轨迹和 QwQ-32B-Preview 长链语料分别参与下游实验，使因果归因更复杂。官方训练脚本的轮数与学习率顺序未完全对应论文，仓库还跟踪了带竖线的评测文件名，导致 Windows 下普通 checkout 失败。

发布审计仍不完整：本卡未能独立枚举 Google Drive 文件，亦未核实不可变版本、checksum、精确 rollout schema、入选/淘汰数量和逐条端到端谱系。检查到的 GitHub commit 没有顶层 LICENSE，因此代码、rollout 数据和 checkpoint 的复用许可均为 unknown。也没有发现逐条去污染、近重复、角色泄漏或 verifier 校准报告。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the data-construction and open-release-recipes track, CDG is most useful as a worked example of converting self-play outcomes into several supervision objects rather than as a single undifferentiated dataset. A reusable implementation can derive Prover SFT conversations, Helpful-Critic examples, Misleading-Critic examples, correction preferences, and resistance preferences from the same episode graph.

Curators should preserve the original question and reference answer; initial solution and correctness; critic role and full critique; all four revision candidates and verifier results; selection threshold and outcome; exact prompt template; loop, checkpoint, and decoding configuration; and the final training serialization. Both selected and rejected episodes matter, because a selected-only corpus hides threshold bias and critic failure modes.

The construction is also a useful stress test for feedback robustness: compare acceptance rates for valid and invalid critiques, measure whether role identity leaks through wording, replace the phrase-based rejection test with semantic adjudication, and stratify outcomes by parser confidence and problem source. Reuse claims should distinguish the raw 19,473-question pool, the Google Drive rollout artifact, the converted role datasets, and the Hugging Face checkpoint; they are related but not interchangeable objects.

对“数据构建与开放发布配方”赛道而言，CDG 最有价值之处是展示如何从同一张 episode 图派生多种监督，而不是把它当作一个无差别数据集。一次回合可以生成 Prover SFT 对话、Helpful Critic 样本、Misleading Critic 样本、纠错偏好和抗误导偏好。

复用时应保留原题与标准答案、初始解和正确性、Critic 角色与完整 critique、全部四个 revision 及 verifier 结果、筛选阈值和结论、原始 prompt 模板、轮次、checkpoint、解码设置和最终训练序列化。入选与淘汰回合都需要保留，否则仅看入选数据无法审计阈值偏差和 Critic 失败模式。

这套构造还适合用来压力测试反馈鲁棒性：比较有效与无效 critique 的采纳率，测量角色措辞泄漏，以语义判定替换固定短语，并按 parser 置信度和题目来源分层分析。任何复用说明都应区分 19,473 条原始题目、Google Drive rollout、转换后的角色数据和 Hugging Face checkpoint；它们互有关联，但不是同一种数据对象。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat (question, initial solution, critique, revised solution) as the semantic episode; retain role, correctness, loop, selection, and checkpoint fields around it.
  • Helpful feedback is tested on initially wrong answers; misleading feedback is tested on initially correct answers. The Prover is not told which role produced the critique.
  • Main selection uses four revisions per critique, with thresholds of at least two corrected revisions for Helpful Critic and at least three successful attacks for Misleading Critic.
  • The exact rejection string is part of the verifier contract, not a cosmetic prompt detail; audit surface-form gaming and false negatives.
  • The repository's 19,473-row data/train.jsonl is the raw question pool, not proof that the linked rollout corpus has the same schema or count.
  • Read the non-monotonic CDG-1/CDG-2 results, script–paper mismatches, separate downstream data pipelines, unknown licenses, and missing immutable rollout manifest before reuse.

• 把 (question, initial solution, critique, revised solution) 视为语义 episode，并在外围保留角色、正确性、轮次、筛选和 checkpoint 字段。
  • Helpful Critic 面向初始错误答案，Misleading Critic 面向初始正确答案；Prover 不知道 critique 来自哪个角色。
  • 主筛选对每条 critique 采样四次 revision：Helpful Critic 至少两次纠正，Misleading Critic 至少三次成功误导。
  • 固定拒绝短语属于 verifier 契约，不是无关紧要的 prompt 细节；必须审计表面形式投机和误拒问题。
  • 仓库中的 19,473 条 data/train.jsonl 是原始题池，不能据此推断 Google Drive rollout 具有相同 schema 或数量。
  • 复用前应同时阅读 CDG-1/CDG-2 的非单调结果、论文—脚本差异、独立下游数据流程、unknown 许可和缺失的不可变 rollout 清单。
